question: According to the sport, identify which of the following sportspersons is different from the rest.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Leander Paes**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Leander Paes is India's professional*** tennis player***.
 
• In the history of*** doubles tennis***, he is recognized as one of the best players.
 
• For*** Davis Cup*** doubles victories, he currently retains the record.
 
• Paes captured ten ***Grand Slams*** in the mixed doubles category and eight in the men's doubles.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ***Anil Kumble:***

 
 
• ​Anil Kumble played test and one-day international cricket for his country's squad throughout the course of an ***18-year international career***.
 
• He is a former Indian ***cricket captain***, ***coach***, and ***commentator***.
 
 
 
• ***Rahul Dravid:***
 
 
• ​Former Indian national team captain and current head coach Rahul Sharad Dravid is an ***Indian cricket coach.***
 
• Dravid was the*** Head of Cricket at the National Cricket Academy*** and the head coach of the India Under-19 and India A teams before being appointed to the senior men's national squad.
 
 
 
• ***Kapil Dev:***
 
 
• ​Former*** Indian cricketer K***apil Dev Ramlal Nikhanj was a hard-hitting middle-order batsman and a fast-medium bowler.
 
• In 2002, Wisden named him the*** Indian Cricketer of the Century***.
